title: Best of Denver Bus Tour: Highlights, Views & Local Favorites
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
All guests must be age 5+ due to state/car seat laws & insurance requirements.
All guests must be ticketed, regardless of age, as vehicle capacity is limited to 14-guests. Unticketed guests will not be able to join.
policies: Total Duration is 1 hour & 30-minutes to 1 hour & 45-minutes, including the driving time
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Come join this fun Mile High City bus tour with our Discover Denver Tours team & jump into exploring the Mile High City. Hop onboard our comfy 14-passenger bus & take in Denver's top sights as we wind through Denver & visit a great spot for mountain & city views. Denver's beauty shines year-round & experiencing Denver's top sights & discovering the stories behind them, is a great way to kick off your time in Denver. 

Along the way, enjoy lots of fun stories from your guide, ask Qs, snap pics of Denver's amazing landmarks, and see & hear more about the Mile High City's unique sights.

Your tour kicks off at Union Station & then we'll hit the streets, rolling past some favorites, including the iconic Larimer Square, the unique Denver Art Museum, we'll explore LoDo together, check out the must-see 16th Street Mall, hear the U.S. Mint's heist stories, visit the famous Mile High Steps & much more!

This is the best bus tour for first-time visitors & a great first day activity.
Ages 6+ only
